Advertising and publishing

Google AdSense account reinstatement

AdSense accounts are most often disabled for invalid traffic. The appeal has to show where your traffic comes from, what went wrong, and why it will not happen again.

Start a Google AdSense caseCheck your readiness
  • Independent: not affiliated with any platform
  • Confidential from the first message
  • Honest about the odds

Why Google AdSense suspends accounts

Common triggers we see in Google AdSense cases:

  • Invalid traffic: accidental self-clicks, bots, paid traffic of poor quality, or click encouragement
  • Program policy violations on content or ad placement
  • Site behavior issues such as misleading navigation around ads

What your Google AdSense notice usually means

“Your AdSense account has been disabled due to invalid traffic”

Serving stops. Earnings from invalid activity can be withheld. An appeal form is available.

“Policy violation: ad serving limited or disabled on page”

A page or site level issue. Fix it and request a review in the Policy center.

Wording varies. Search more phrases in the Suspension Notice Decoder.

The official route

  1. Audit analytics for traffic sources, spikes and referrers around the dates in question.
  2. Remove or fix the traffic sources and placements responsible.
  3. Submit the invalid traffic appeal with specific findings, or request review in Policy center for policy issues.

Evidence that carries weight

  • Analytics exports by source, country and date
  • Records of paid traffic campaigns and vendors
  • Server logs for suspicious spikes

Held funds

AdSense can withhold earnings associated with invalid traffic. Whether earnings are paid depends on the outcome and on Google's findings.

How held-funds support works

What we prepare for your Google AdSense case

You receive

  • Written diagnosis of your Google AdSense notice and the policy it cites
  • Root cause statement drawn from your own account data
  • Evidence gap list and document consistency check
  • Appeal or Plan of Action text written for the Google AdSense reviewer
  • Submission guidance and follow-up reply drafts
  • Held-funds classification and release request planning

What we cannot do

  • Reinstate the account ourselves: only Google AdSense can make that decision
  • Supply, edit or source documents, or describe fixes that have not happened
  • Help you open a new account or get around enforcement

How the case runs

01

Diagnose

Read the notice, the policy it cites and your account data until the real cause is clear.

02

Evidence

Build a document pack the platform can verify: nothing padded, nothing altered.

03

Appeal

One precise, factual submission through the official route, written to what was asked.

04

Protect

Keep the account healthy after the decision and release funds where they are held.

Google AdSense reinstatement FAQs

Can I just create a new AdSense account?

No. AdSense terms do not allow new accounts to get around a disabled one. We only work on the original account.

Are you affiliated with Google AdSense?

No. We are an independent case preparation service. We have no special access to Google AdSense, no internal contacts, and we do not claim otherwise. Every submission goes through the official route Google AdSense provides to account holders.

Can you guarantee reinstatement?

No one can honestly guarantee a platform decision. What we control is the quality of the diagnosis, the evidence and the written response. We tell you at the review stage if we think the case is weak, and why.

Related platforms

YouTube

YouTube channel reinstatement and strike appeals

YouTube channels are terminated after three Community Guidelines strikes within 90 days, for a single severe violation, or for copyright strikes. Each route has its own appeal and they are not forgiving of weak submissions.

Read more Google Ads

Google Ads account suspension appeals

Google Ads suspensions are policy decisions against the account, not individual ads. We work out which policy, fix what the reviewer will check, and prepare one strong appeal.

Google Merchant Center suspension and misrepresentation

Merchant Center misrepresentation is usually about trust signals on your website and feed. We audit what a reviewer sees and fix it before a review is requested.
